practiceQuestions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the establishment of a Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 280 of the Constitution provides for a Finance Commission as a quasi-judicial body.

practiceQuestions.q: The Finance Commission is constituted by the President of India at the expiration of every:
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 280(1), the Finance Commission is constituted by the President every five years, or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary.

practiceQuestions.q: What is the total membership of the Finance Commission (including the Chairman)?
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 280(1) states that the Commission shall consist of a Chairman and four other members.

practiceQuestions.q: Who determines the qualifications of the members of the Finance Commission?
opts: The Parliament of India by law
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 280(2) specifies that Parliament may by law determine the qualifications which shall be requisite for appointment as members of the Commission.

practiceQuestions.q: Under which Act of Parliament are the qualifications for Finance Commission members specified?
opts: The Representation of the People Act, 1951
practiceQuestions.sol: Parliament passed the Finance Commission (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1951 to define the qualifications and selection criteria of members.

practiceQuestions.q: The Chairman of the Finance Commission must be a person having:
opts: Qualifications of a High Court Judge
Wide experience in financial matters and administration
practiceQuestions.sol: According to the Finance Commission Act, 1951, the Chairman must be a person having experience in public affairs.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following is NOT a qualification prescribed for the other four members of the Finance Commission?
opts: A person who is, or has been, or is qualified to be appointed as a Judge of a High Court
A person who has special knowledge of finance and accounts of government
A person who has wide experience in financial matters and in administration
A person who has special knowledge of the Indian judicial administration system
practiceQuestions.sol: Prescribed qualifications for members include: (1) HC Judge eligibility, (2) Finance & Accounts knowledge, (3) Financial Admin experience, and (4) Special knowledge of Economics. Judicial administration system is not a criteria.

practiceQuestions.q: Are the members of the Finance Commission eligible for reappointment?
opts: No, they are never eligible for reappointment
Yes, they are eligible for reappointment
Only the Chairman is eligible for reappointment
Yes, but only after a cooling-off period of five years
practiceQuestions.sol: Unlike UPSC members, members of the Finance Commission are eligible for reappointment under the rules of the Finance Commission Act, 1951.

practiceQuestions.q: Who lays the recommendations of the Finance Commission before each House of Parliament?
opts: The Chairman of the Finance Commission
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 281, the President shall cause every recommendation made by the Finance Commission, together with an explanatory memorandum, to be laid before each House of Parliament.

practiceQuestions.q: The recommendations of the Finance Commission regarding sharing of tax revenues are:
opts: Advisory in nature and not binding on the Government
Strictly binding on the Union Government
Binding only if approved by both Houses of Parliament by special majority
practiceQuestions.sol: The recommendations are advisory in nature, though by convention the vertical devolution is accepted by the Union Government.

practiceQuestions.q: Which article of the Constitution deals with the 'Grants-in-aid' from the Union to the States?
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 275 deals with statutory Grants-in-aid of the revenues of the States, which are recommended by the Finance Commission.

practiceQuestions.q: Under Article 280, the Commission recommends the distribution of 'net proceeds' of taxes. What is meant by 'net proceeds'?
opts: Gross tax revenue collected by the Union
Tax proceeds minus the cost of collection, certified by the CAG
Tax proceeds including cesses and surcharges
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 279, 'net proceeds' means the proceeds of any tax or duty reduced by the cost of its collection, as certified by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG).

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following taxes/charges are excluded from the divisible pool of taxes shared with States under Article 270?
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 271, surcharges and cesses levied for specific purposes are excluded from the divisible pool and belong solely to the Union.

practiceQuestions.q: What was the vertical devolution share recommended by the 14th Finance Commission under Dr. Y.V. Reddy?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 14th Finance Commission recommended a historic increase in vertical devolution from 32% to 42%.

practiceQuestions.q: What vertical tax devolution share to States was recommended by the 15th Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 15th Finance Commission recommended vertical devolution of 41% to States.

practiceQuestions.q: Why did the 15th Finance Commission reduce the vertical tax devolution to States from 42% to 41%?
opts: To punish states for not meeting demographic targets
To allocate 1% for the newly formed Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
To offset losses from the COVID-19 pandemic
To reduce fiscal deficits of the Union
practiceQuestions.sol: The 1% adjustment (reducing the share from 42% to 41%) was to provide resources for the reorganization of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh into Union Territories, which are funded by the Centre.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the First Finance Commission of India?
practiceQuestions.sol: K.C. Neogy was the Chairman of the First Finance Commission, constituted in 1951.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the Chairman of the 15th Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: N.K. Singh served as the Chairman of the 15th Finance Commission.

practiceQuestions.q: Who has been appointed as the Chairman of the 16th Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: Dr. Arvind Panagariya (former Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog) has been appointed as the Chairman of the 16th Finance Commission.

practiceQuestions.q: Which criterion carried the highest weight in the horizontal devolution formula of the 15th Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: Income Distance carried the highest weight of 45% in the 15th Finance Commission's horizontal tax distribution formula.

practiceQuestions.q: What was the weight assigned to 'Population (2011 Census)' by the 15th Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 15th Finance Commission assigned a weight of 15% to Population (2011 Census).

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following is a new criterion introduced by the 15th Finance Commission to reward states for controlling their population growth?
practiceQuestions.sol: Demographic Performance (weight of 12.5%) was introduced to reward states that successfully reduced their Total Fertility Rate (TFR).

practiceQuestions.q: What weight did the 15th Finance Commission assign to the 'Forest and Ecology' criterion?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 15th Finance Commission assigned a weight of 10% to Forest and Ecology, compensating states for maintaining green cover.

practiceQuestions.q: Which Article governs the appointment of a State Finance Commission in India?
practiceQuestions.sol: State Finance Commissions (SFCs) are appointed by Governors under Article 243-I (and Article 243-Y for Municipalities) to review financial positions of local bodies.

practiceQuestions.q: Who appoints the State Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Governor of the State appoints the State Finance Commission every five years under Article 243-I.

practiceQuestions.q: The Union Finance Commission recommends measures to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State to assist Panchayats based on recommendations of:
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 280(3)(bb), the Union Finance Commission recommends measures based on the recommendations of the State Finance Commission.

practiceQuestions.q: The salary, allowances, and service conditions of the members of the Finance Commission are determined by:
practiceQuestions.sol: Parliament determines the conditions of service, salary, and allowances of the members under the Finance Commission Act, 1951.

practiceQuestions.q: The first Finance Commission of India was established in the year:
practiceQuestions.sol: The First Finance Commission was established by presidential order in November 1951.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Finance Commission of India?
opts: Recommending distribution of net proceeds of taxes between Union and States
Recommending principles governing grants-in-aid of state revenues
Formulating five-year plans for economic development
Suggesting measures to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State
practiceQuestions.sol: Formulating five-year plans was the function of the Planning Commission (now replaced by NITI Aayog), not the Finance Commission.

practiceQuestions.q: Who acts as the final authority to certify the 'net proceeds' of any tax in India?
opts: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 279(1), the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India certifies the net proceeds of any tax or duty, and this certificate is final.

practiceQuestions.q: Which constitutional amendment added the duty of augmenting the Consolidated Fund of a State for Panchayats to the Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 added Article 280(3)(bb) to help strengthen Panchayat finance.

practiceQuestions.q: Which constitutional amendment added the duty of augmenting the Consolidated Fund of a State for Municipalities to the Finance Commission?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 added Article 280(3)(c) to support urban local bodies (Municipalities).

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following bodies is constitutional in nature?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Finance Commission is a constitutional body (Article 280). NITI Aayog, NDC, and Law Commission are non-constitutional, executive, or statutory bodies.

practiceQuestions.q: Which body is historically described as the 'balancing wheel of fiscal federalism' in India?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Finance Commission has traditionally been described as the balancing wheel of fiscal federalism in India.

practiceQuestions.q: The horizontal devolution formula weights for Area and Population (2011) used by the 15th Finance Commission are respectively:
practiceQuestions.sol: Both Area and Population (2011) carry a weight of 15% each in the 15th FC formula.

practiceQuestions.q: What weight did the 15th Finance Commission assign to the 'Tax and Fiscal Effort' criterion?
practiceQuestions.sol: Tax and Fiscal Effort was assigned a weight of 2.5% to incentivize fiscal discipline.

practiceQuestions.q: Under Article 280, who can make a reference to the Finance Commission on 'any other matter' in the interest of sound finance?
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 280(3)(d) states that the President can refer 'any other matter' to the Commission in the interests of sound finance.

practiceQuestions.q: The recommendations of the Finance Commission cover a period of:
practiceQuestions.sol: Recommendations generally cover a period of 5 years (except the 15th FC which made reports for 6 years: 2020-21 and 2021-26 due to UT formation and COVID).

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following is correct regarding the qualifications of the Chairman of the Finance Commission?
opts: Must be a retired Supreme Court Judge
Must have experience in public affairs
Must be appointed by the Prime Minister
Must be under the age of 65
practiceQuestions.sol: The Chairman must have experience in public affairs under the Finance Commission Act, 1951.

practiceQuestions.q: Can the Union government accept some recommendations of the Finance Commission and reject others?
opts: No, it must accept all or reject all
Yes, the government has the discretion to accept or reject any advice since it is advisory
No, recommendations must be fully accepted as they are statutory
Yes, but only with Supreme Court clearance
practiceQuestions.sol: Since the recommendations are advisory, the Union Cabinet has full discretion to choose which recommendations to implement.

practiceQuestions.q: Which constitutional amendment made the recommendations of the Finance Commission regarding tax devolution apply to all central taxes (divisible pool) rather than just income tax and excise?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 80th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2000 introduced an 'Alternative Scheme of Devolution' under which all central taxes were pooled for sharing.

practiceQuestions.q: How does the GST Council differ from the Finance Commission?
opts: GST Council is statutory while FC is constitutional
GST Council decides tax rates and structure, while FC decides vertical/horizontal revenue distribution
FC is a permanent body while GST Council is temporary
GST Council has no state representatives while FC has only state representatives
practiceQuestions.sol: The GST Council decides rates, exemptions, and administrative aspects of GST, whereas the Finance Commission decides the distribution of tax revenues between Union and States.

practiceQuestions.q: Which Article deals with the action taken report or explanatory memorandum on Finance Commission recommendations?
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 281 deals with the Action Taken Report (explanatory memorandum) showing why recommendations were or were not implemented.

practiceQuestions.q: The term 'Income Distance' in horizontal devolution refers to the difference between:
opts: A state's GSDP and the national average GDP
A state's per capita income and that of the state with the highest per capita income
State tax revenue and central grants
Urban and rural incomes in a state
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Income Distance' is the gap between a state's per capita income and the per capita income of the top-ranking state (which was Goa/Haryana depending on proxy controls).

practiceQuestions.q: Which census population data was used by the 14th Finance Commission?
opts: 1971 and 2011 Census data with different weights
practiceQuestions.sol: The 14th Finance Commission used both 1971 population (17.5% weight) and 2011 population (10% weight) to balance needs and historical performance.

practiceQuestions.q: The 15th Finance Commission was constituted in which year?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 15th Finance Commission was constituted by the President of India in November 2017.

practiceQuestions.q: The term of the 15th Finance Commission's recommendations was extended to cover which final period?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 15th FC recommendations cover a six-year period: an interim report for 2020-21, followed by a main report for 2021-22 to 2025-26.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following is NOT recommended by the Finance Commission?
opts: Distribution of net tax proceeds between Union and States
Allocation of capital market borrowable quotas to states
Principles governing grants-in-aid to States under Article 275
Augmenting state consolidated funds to supplement municipal resources
practiceQuestions.sol: Capital borrowing limits are regulated directly by the Ministry of Finance under Article 293, not by the Finance Commission.

practiceQuestions.q: Under the Finance Commission Act, 1951, members must be appointed by the President by:
opts: Order under his hand and seal
practiceQuestions.sol: The members and Chairman are appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.

practiceQuestions.q: Who acts as the Secretary of the Finance Commission?
opts: A senior civil servant appointed by the Commission with Government approval
An economist nominated by NITI Aayog
practiceQuestions.sol: The Secretary of the Commission is usually a senior IAS officer appointed by the Union government to manage the secretariat.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the horizontal tax devolution of the 15th Finance Commission:
1. The demographic performance criterion rewards states with higher total fertility rates.
2. The 1971 Census data was completely dropped from the 15th FC devolution formula.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect: Demographic performance rewards states with *lower* fertility rates. Statement 2 is correct: The 15th FC dropped the 1971 population data completely, relying solely on 2011 population data.

mockTestQuestions.q:
With reference to the Finance Commission, consider the following statements:
1. The Constitution specifies the age of retirement for the members as 65 years.
2. A member of the Commission can be disqualified if they are declared of unsound mind.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect: The Constitution does not specify the age of retirement; it is regulated by the Finance Commission Act, 1951. Statement 2 is correct: A member can be disqualified if declared of unsound mind, insolvent, or convicted of an offense involving moral turpitude.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Which of the following is/are the recommendations made by the Finance Commission to the President?
1. The allocation of borrowing limits to states under Article 293.
2. The principles which should govern the grants-in-aid of the revenues of the States out of the Consolidated Fund of India.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
mockTestQuestions.sol: Devolution of borrowing quotas is governed by Article 293 (regulated by the Union Executive), not the Finance Commission. Finance Commission recommends principles governing Grants-in-aid (Article 275).

mockTestQuestions.q:
With reference to the Finance Commission Act, 1951, which of the following is/are requirements for a member of the Commission?
1. A person who is qualified to be appointed as a Judge of a High Court.
2. A person who has special knowledge of financial administration and public sector management.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
mockTestQuestions.sol: Under the Act, a member must have (1) HC Judge eligibility, (2) Finance/Accounts knowledge, (3) Financial Admin experience, or (4) Special Economics knowledge. Option 2 is incorrect because the Act says 'financial matters and in administration' generally, not specifically 'public sector management'.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Which of the following factors are included in the horizontal devolution formula of the 15th Finance Commission?
1. Income Distance
2. Demographic Performance
3. Forest and Ecology
4. Infrastructure Index
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
mockTestQuestions.sol: Criteria include Income Distance (45%), Demographic Performance (12.5%), and Forest & Ecology (10%). Infrastructure Index is NOT a criterion in the 15th FC devolution formula.

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Finance Commission is a permanent constitutional body.
2. The recommendations of the Finance Commission are placed before Parliament along with an Action Taken Report.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect: The Finance Commission is a *temporary* body constituted every 5 years (or earlier) by the President. Statement 2 is correct: Under Article 281, recommendations must be laid before Parliament along with an Action Taken Report.

mockTestQuestions.q:
With reference to the devolution of taxes, consider the following statements:
1. Cesses and surcharges are distributed between the Union and the States based on the Finance Commission's recommendations.
2. The 80th Constitutional Amendment brought all central taxes into the divisible pool.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect: Cesses and surcharges are excluded from the divisible pool. Statement 2 is correct: The 80th Amendment (2000) brought all central taxes and duties into the divisible pool (Alternative Scheme of Devolution).

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the State Finance Commission (SFC):
1. The SFC is appointed by the Governor of the State under Article 243-I.
2. The Union Finance Commission has no relationship with the recommendations of the SFC.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: The Governor appoints the SFC under Article 243-I. Statement 2 is incorrect: The Union Finance Commission must recommend measures to augment State Consolidated Funds based on SFC recommendations.

mockTestQuestions.q:
With reference to Article 275 of the Constitution of India, consider the following statements:
1. All grants-in-aid under Article 275 are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India.
2. The Finance Commission recommends both general and specific purpose grants under this Article.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. Article 275 grants are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India (non-votable) and the FC recommends both revenue deficit grants (general) and specific local body/disaster grants.

mockTestQuestions.q: The first Finance Commission was appointed in 1951. Since then, how many Finance Commissions have been appointed so far?
mockTestQuestions.sol: As of 2024, 16 Finance Commissions have been appointed by the President, with the 16th chaired by Dr. Arvind Panagariya.
